stories.title: Exotic pets, family houses and Legos: Here's what NFL rookies have spent their first paychecks on
stories.summary: Jeremiyah Love, Drew Allar and Carnell Tate are among the NFL rookies who just got their first pro contracts. How did they spend their new money?

stories.title: White rips critics, backed by Fever after fans boo
stories.summary: Fever coach Stephanie White spoke out against her critics and received vocal support from Caitlin Clark and Sophie Cunningham after she was booed in Indiana before Tuesday's win over the Liberty.

stories.title: Trimble leaves UNC 'home,' commits to Louisville
stories.summary: Seth Trimble has committed to play for Louisville next season following the court ruling that gave class of 2022 high schoolers a fifth season of college eligibility.

stories.title: Ex-QB Hasselbeck joins effort to find CTE in living
stories.summary: Former NFL quarterback Matt Hasselbeck recently spent two days going through a battery of scans and tests to determine how much collisions affected his brain. The hope is that it will be a small step toward diagnosing CTE in the living.

stories.title: Skenes lifted after 65 pitches, mum on velo drop
stories.summary: Paul Skenes, battling another dip in his fastball velocity, was lifted after just 65 pitches in Tuesday's loss to the Marlins, leading to further speculation about the health status of the reigning National League Cy Young Award winner.
